system of an area. Look at the physical
map. You will notice that small streams
flowing from different directions come together
to form the main river, which ultimately drains
into a large water body such as a lake or a sea
or an ocean. The area drained by a single river
system is called a drainage basin. A closer

activities.subject: Social
activities.question: Explain the main idea of Chapter 3.
activities.instructions: Use the source-based options to complete this activity.

correctItems.text: DRAINAGE T he term drainage describes the river system of an area.
The area drained by a single river system is called a drainage basin.
A closer observation on a map will indicate that any elevated area, such as a mountain or an upland, separates two drainage basins.
Accordingly, the Indian rivers are divided into two major groups: • the Himalayan rivers; and • the Peninsular rivers.
